integrity_statement: Originality excludes preexisting uniform-source minimizer optima. A possible prior unindexed weighted analysis and limited full-text access to a dataset-adaptive source remain explicit bibliographic uncertainties. There has been no external independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact result only for iid Bernoulli binary streams, fixed strict two-mer orders and window widths 2 through 9; finite-order exhaustive algebra is not a theorem for arbitrary alphabet, k, w or correlations. The numerical benefit is modest at some biases.
title: Two-switch optimality for biased binary two-mer minimizers at the first exceptional window
